title: Volume Under an Inverted Paraboloid Above the xy-Plane
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the solid under the paraboloid z = 9 - x^2 - y^2 above the xy-plane.

steps.title: Determine Boundary of Base Region in xy-Plane
steps.mathExpression: z = 0 \implies 9 - x^2 - y^2 = 0 \implies x^2 + y^2 = 9 \implies r = 3
steps.explanation: The base is a circle of radius 3 centered at the origin.

steps.title: Set Up Polar Volume Integral
steps.mathExpression: V = \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^3 (9 - r^2) r \, dr \, d\theta = 2\pi \int_0^3 (9r - r^3) \, dr
steps.explanation: Multiply integrand (9 - r^2) by Jacobian factor r.
